organization.notes: Pingdom history labels 2007 Founded and joined SolarWinds in 2014; this is Pingdom product/business history, not SolarWinds founding. Funding classification covers the current SolarWinds parent group: the April 16, 2025 completion announcement explicitly identifies private equity firm Turn/River Capital as SolarWinds new owner and confirms delisting. Turn/River is listed solely as the current parent-level private equity owner, not as a historical direct investor in independent Pingdom. Historical Pingdom equity funding remains unresolved.
